verdict.rationale: Skills are a documented first-class feature of the official Claude Agent SDK: sessions can control which skills Claude invokes, dispatch them by name, and discover authored skills. Plugin skills are also usable in the SDK. On the API side, skills are passed via the Messages API `container` parameter and uploaded and managed through the Skills API. missing for 10: evidence of specific language SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript) with code samples, SDK versioning/stability details, independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.
